scope: Selected B2-A only: two closed plain books and a linen bookmark beside the existing console lamp; existing dish moved forward 3.8cm. B1 and cameras retained; B3 pending author content. No publication or deployment changes.

method.runtime: Shared Node 24.14.0, existing Playwright, system Chrome 156.0.8078.80, ANGLE Metal Apple M1 Pro; no installation or isolated environment.
method.browserRouting: Browser plugin not available; existing Playwright and system Chrome used.
method.script: Unchanged scripts/measure-performance.mjs via local measure.mjs, development server 5173. DPR1, CPU1x, reduced motion, clear simulated weather, no birds/vessels, default warm 50% room light.
method.dayNight: 1280x800, ordinary quality, fixed scene time 2026-10-31 12:00 / 22:00. Each before/after group contains three serial five-second samples.
method.phone: 390x844, low quality, fixed scene time 2026-10-31 22:00, one five-second sample before and after; desktop browser size emulation, not a physical phone.
method.isolation: GPU QA and sample groups ran serially; source frozen in each sample group. Temporary caffeinate used to prevent idle system sleep.
method.limits: Refresh-limited short samples do not prove speedup or net GPU cost. CPU submission is not GPU completion. No Safari, physical phone, battery, thermal or GPU memory validation.

resourceChanges.description: Two merged opaque book batches and one closed linen ribbon. Ribbon map/bump reuses the existing homeFabric. Static geometry, no frame updates, new lights or dependencies; scene aggregate owns disposal. Existing manual shadow-quality variants warm once and subsequent complete cycles reuse them. New books are outside the original phone portrait view and use existing frustum culling.

validation.flow: Production entry, two distinct fog/door clicks, original lamp-side books, light controls, cat view, album next chapter and room return.
validation.build: Final project-pnpm run typecheck and project-pnpm run build passed; 107 modules, app 387.86KB/gzip143.98KB, Three 585.94KB/gzip150.15KB. Existing Three.js large-chunk warning retained.
